headline: The End of Tax-Free Shopping: What Bill 15460 Means for Temu and AliExpress Buyers - sud.ua
summary: Ukraine's Verkhovna Rada passed Bill No. 15460, which changes customs clearance rules for international parcels. The document aims to harmonise customs law with EU rules, with the main change for citizens being the new clearance regime.
why: Cross-border e-commerce platforms such as Temu and AliExpress rely on duty-free parcel rules, so changes to customs treatment can affect their pricing and sales volumes in the affected market.
